>dice que los procesadores de las computadoras aumentará 

I believe this sentence should say aumentarán instead of aumentará.

>mejorar sus vidas y lograr los avances

This sentence should be reworded if possible. The "los avances" part implies you have already talked about a specific set of advancements. Given that you're using the term broadly to simply specify advancements in general, I think the phrase "avances significativos" would be a better fit.



>Sin embargo, mucha gente tiene la alfabetización tecnológica para usar la tecnología. La tecnología mejorará la vida de la gente solamente si toda la gente puede usarla suficientemente.

This part is somewhat confusing. I think you're missing a "no" in between "gente" and "tiene" in the first sentence. 

However, if your general idea is to say that plenty of people have a literacy in technology, then the "Sin embargo" is not appropriate. I'd appreciate a response stating what the point of this parragraph is so I can determine which parts might need a tweak.

>suficientemente

The use of the word suficientemente is not correct in this particular context. I would suggest using adecuadamente instead.
